/** Calls fetch outside the downloader. */
export async function download(url: string): Promise<string> {
  const response = await fetch(url);
  return response.text();
}

/** A method named fetch is not the global fetch. */
export class Cache {
  /** Not the global. */
  fetch(key: string): string {
    return key;
  }

  /** Calls the global once more. */
  async fill(key: string): Promise<void> {
    await fetch(this.fetch(key));
  }
}
